sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text:
Bebo is an Irish heroine. She was the small wife of the tiny fairy king Iubdán. She traveled with this husband to the land of Ulster. The region seemed full of giants to the pair. The lovely queen caught the eye of the Ulster king, Fergus.

Bebo became Fergus's mistress for a year. The bond held despite the great physical difference. Fergus then gave Bebo back. Her husband offered him a pair of magical shoes. The enchanted pair sealed the exchange.

okr.objective: Tell of Bebo, the fairy queen who became mistress of Fergus of Ulster.
key_results: Bebo was the small wife of the fairy king.
